description: This file defines the ChargeWorkbookPopulator class responsible for creating and configuring an Excel workbook sheet for charge data import, setting column layouts and headers.

classes.name: ChargeWorkbookPopulator
classes.description: A class that populates an Excel workbook with charge-related sheet layout and headers, extending AbstractWorkbookPopulator.

methods.name: populate
methods.description: Creates a sheet in the workbook for charges and initializes its layout.

methods.name: setLayout
methods.description: Sets up the column widths and headers for the charge sheet.

methods.name: setRules
methods.description: Defines validation rules for the sheet; currently commented out and unused.
